title: Editor E6 slice: rows on the canvas can be added, moved, split and taken off, with Undo
detail:
Split from PROG-E6 on 2026-11-16, after PROG-E6C, whose own known limit was: rows and columns themselves still cannot be added, removed or reordered here. Dark; the EDITOR_CANVAS default is unchanged.

Premise re-tested (ADR-1082): the node document already had pure row ops (lib/entity-blocks/node-row-ops.ts: addNodeRow, removeNodeRow, moveNodeRow, setNodeRowSplit). No document shape change, no migration and no SQL. A Space page holds at most two columns (MAX_COLUMNS_BY_KIND), so the canvas offers one column, two even, wide left and wide right, and nothing wider; the action's schema refuses a wider split.

What now works. In Layers, each row has its own tools when the page can change: Up and Down, a columns picker, Add a row below, and Remove row. A new row is empty. Only an empty row can be removed, and never the last. A split can only drop columns that are already empty (the picker shows the others but they cannot be picked, and the server refuses them too). So no row change moves, folds, benches or loses a block, and the selected block stays selected. Every row change rides the same draft action (saveCanvasNodeDraft) and the same guarded write as PROG-E6B and E6C, and goes on the same undo stack: a move goes back the other way, a split goes back to the split before, removing an empty row is undone by adding one at its index, and adding a row is undone by removing it once the server names it. Refusals say why in plain words.

VERIFIED: unit tests for the split read, the split guard and the row undo math; the action end to end with the data layer mocked (add at an index, the 24-row cap, move and the edge, every split, a narrowing that would drop a block, removing an empty row and refusing a full one, a split wider than a Space page); the client queue under jsdom (add, move, split, then three undos in reverse; a refused row change drops its undo); the row tools rendered and clicked. Driven in Chromium: the shipped canvas bundled with the real action and model, only auth, flags and the database stubbed (a throwaway harness, not committed), at 390px: Add a row below, Wide left, Up, then Undo three times, the stored draft checked after each step. Pictures at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000 px, light and dark, in /mnt/project-files/editor/e6d/. NOT VERIFIED: the live route with a signed-in staff account and a database (this box has neither); no finger on a real phone.

Known limits, stated plainly: a row's title, live header and margins are still set in the Space page builder, not here; the frame still draws only the selected block, not the page; there is no redo.

verify.note: Runs the shipped draft action and canvas read with only framework, auth and database replaced. Fails on main: the draft action has no row changes and Layers has no row tools. Passes when a new empty row lands at its index with the block still selected, a row moves and is refused past the edge, every split stores and reads back, a split that would drop a block is refused, only an empty row comes off and never the last, a split wider than a Space page is refused, nothing writes with the switch off, for non-staff or read-only, and the canvas mounts the row tools.
